The Work

Meta Ads Built for Detailers. Managed by Someone Who Actually Watches Your Numbers.

We write the copy, build the creatives, and set the targeting — everything built around detailing-specific language. Full details. Paint correction. Ceramic coating. We know the difference, and so do your customers.

Our team personally monitors every campaign. Not an account manager. Not a VA. When something's off, it gets caught and fixed fast — not at the next monthly check-in.

We test constantly. Ads that stop working get replaced. Ads that work get scaled. Your budget doesn't sit idle waiting for a quarterly review.

Industry-Specific Creative

Copy and visuals written for detailing customers — not generic "local business" templates that could be for anyone.

Direct Oversight, Every Day

We watch your metrics personally. Performance drops get addressed in hours, not weeks.

Continuous Testing

Multiple ad variations run simultaneously. We find what converts and put more budget behind it.

Local Targeting Precision

Ads shown to the right people in your actual service area — not a broad radius that wastes spend on people who won't drive to you.

The Process

From Call to Live Ads in 7 Days

1
Day 1

Discovery Call

We learn your business, your market, and your goals. What services do you want to fill? What's your average ticket? What's worked before, what hasn't? No cookie-cutter approach — the strategy starts here.

2
Days 2–7

Build & Launch

We write copy, build creatives, configure targeting, and set up tracking. You review and approve before anything goes live. Most clients are running ads within a week of onboarding.

3

We watch the numbers, kill what's not working, and scale what is. You get regular updates. You focus on the cars — we handle everything on the ad side.
